$comment: Member kinds this lexicon supplies to a chant workspace (#3179). chant reads this file as data and never imports the lexicon. The cloudformation graph block (#3179) reads the template as data (src/workspace-member.ts). The cdk graph block reads the cloud assembly the app already synthesized (cdk.out, or the output cdk.json names) with the same template reader; chant never runs the app, and with no assembly the member says synthesized: false on meta.awsMember.
